summary: The portal has public privacy-policy and terms pages, in English and Traditional Chinese, that anyone can read without signing in.
details: The pages are at /en/privacy, /en/terms, /zh-Hant/privacy and /zh-Hant/terms, and /privacy and /terms open the Chinese ones.
The privacy policy states how Nora uses her read-only Google Drive access, including the Google API Services Limited Use statement and how to revoke access.
limitations: The pages describe Nora's current Google Drive use only; they do not cover other services.
